title: The Ambitious young clerk
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：ambitious　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 ambitious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1979 the father wrote of ① an ambitious young clerk in the letter, and everybody in the house said at once that it was ② more ambitious than the one named there the year before. Three months on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the father, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the ambitious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most ambitious young clerk anybody in the house had ever seen, or so the letter for September 1973 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too ambitious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the neighbour who had come to help; the ambitious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the chair at the far door, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an ambitious plan for the town, and said that no neighbour in his right mind would call it ⑥ as ambitious as the plan for the town they had once had in the old house. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was ambitious or not, and he said so.

By 1986 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the letter. What the line asked for was ⑦ something ambitious, and nothing besides. The neighbour from the next house called the whole plan ⑧ quite ambitious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the letter kept the names of the ambitious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1989, in silence, she wrote of another ambitious young clerk in the same letter, and the work, which took two months, seemed  more ambitious than anybody had expected.  The most ambitious plan for the town in the whole house, she said in 1991, was the one she could never quite name; the ambitious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 有抱负（前置定语 an ambitious young clerk：1979 年父亲在家书里记下的那件有抱负的职员）
B. adj. 有抱负／雄心勃勃（比较级 more ambitious than：文中两处，一处比年轻的职员，一处比预想）
C. adj. 有抱负／雄心勃勃（最高级 the most ambitious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 有抱负（表语 too ambitious to do：母亲觉得它太有抱负，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 雄心勃勃（前置定语 an ambitious plan for the town：叔叔把整件事称作一桩雄心勃勃的规划）
F. adj. 雄心勃勃（同级比较 as ambitious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩小镇的规划相比）
G. adj. 雄心勃勃（后置定语 something ambitious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 雄心勃勃（受程度副词修饰 quite ambitious：那位邻居的评价）

items.q: the most ambitious young clerk anybody
an ambitious plan for the town

answers.why: ambitious 意为“有抱负”，1979 年父亲在家书里记下的是“一件有抱负的职员”，此处作前置定语 an ambitious young clerk。
ambitious 意为“有抱负”，此处用比较级 more ambitious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
ambitious 意为“有抱负”，家书上 九月 那行字说它是老屋里最有抱负的一件，故用最高级 the most ambitious young clerk。
ambitious 意为“有抱负”，母亲认为这件东西“太有抱负了，谁也用不上”，too ambitious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
ambitious 意为“雄心勃勃”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩雄心勃勃的规划”，此处作前置定语 an ambitious plan for the town。
ambitious 意为“雄心勃勃”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩小镇的规划一样雄心勃勃”，同级比较用 as ambitious as。
ambitious 意为“雄心勃勃”，家书上那半行字要的是“雄心勃勃的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something ambitious。
ambitious 意为“雄心勃勃”，邻老屋来的那位邻居认为这套计划“相当雄心勃勃”，quite 修饰原级 ambitious。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1979 年，父亲在家书里记下了一件有抱负的职员。（an ambitious young clerk）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更有抱负。（more ambitious than …）
母亲觉得它太有抱负，谁也用不上。（too ambitious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩雄心勃勃的规划。（an ambitious plan for the town）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩小镇的规划一样雄心勃勃。（as ambitious as …）
到了 1986 年，家书上只剩半行字：要的是一件雄心勃勃的东西。（something ambitious）
answers: In 1979 the father wrote of an ambitious young clerk in the letter.
Everybody said it was more ambitious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too ambitious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an ambitious plan for the town.
He said nobody would call it as ambitious as the plan for the town they had once had.
By 1986 the letter asked for nothing but something ambitious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 ambitious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1979 the father wrote of an ambitious young clerk in the letter, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most ambitious young clerk in the house, or so the letter says.
My mother thought it too ambitious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an ambitious plan for the town, and nobody argued with him.
The neighbour from the next house called the plan quite ambitious, and everybody laughed.
The ambitious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
